stages.label: continuing-source-and-historical-copy
stages.explanation: The live source has continued after capture; its old snapshot stays quarantined and readable.

stages.label: fresh-live-author-lease
stages.explanation: A new authenticated task and lease exist only in the continuing source, not in the historical copy.

stages.label: initial-plan-observed-current
stages.explanation: Live administrative authority creates a private plan; a separate process confirms unchanged rows at observation.

stages.label: eventless-heartbeat-invalidates-plan
stages.explanation: An ordinary heartbeat changes lease_until without changing runtime revision or events; full-row revalidation rejects the old plan.

stages.label: fresh-plan-after-heartbeat
stages.explanation: A new private plan describes the updated lease and can be revalidated in a later process.

stages.label: later-event-invalidates-plan
stages.explanation: An ordinary task enqueue adds an event without an accepted revision; the previous plan is stale again.

stages.label: final-current-observation
stages.explanation: A third private plan includes the later event; revalidation remains advisory and does not activate the copy.

stages.label: safe-operator-rejections
stages.explanation: Revoked authority, a quarantined live source, an existing plan and an unrelated authorized source are rejected without raw SQL corruption.

limitations: Reconciliation is an advisory observation of one trusted live source and one quarantined bundle; it does not activate either copy or install a source write fence.
Private full-row fingerprints catch eventless SQL changes, while time-based grant and lease validity still depends on the sampled clock.
Successful revalidation describes rows and administrative authority at observation, not future authority or a consumable write permission.
The local database owner, implementation and clock remain trusted; matching events and rows are not external origin or completeness attestations.
No credentials, private plans, fingerprints, manifest, intent or SQLite bytes are exported. The demo checks file permissions without reading plan contents.
The source performs ordinary enqueue, claim and heartbeat actions. Recovery assessment and revalidation use read-only connections; visible before/after observations are saved separately.

Public observation comparisons omit only governance_status's top-level observed_at, freshly sampled on each read; raw timestamps remain in saved observations and addressed proof bodies are untouched. Computed grant expiry flags remain compared, so this is not a proof that all private SQL rows are unchanged.
The unrelated database is a separately bootstrapped fictional fixture with fresh authority, not an activated historical snapshot or a production branch.
All principals and author workers are local and programmed. The workflow establishes neither human understanding nor independent models nor service capacity.
Old approvals, leases, operation IDs and receipts remain historical facts; no automatic authority or provenance transfer is performed.
